_comment: Things that block the way until the right tool clears them. Place in Tiled as 'obstacle' objects covering whole tiles (property 'obstacle' = id). They come back every time the area reloads. Tiled property 'passable_from' (left/right) lets the explorer push through from that side (taking push_damage), so obstacles never trap anyone. 'requires' is an item tag (see items.json); 'hits' is how many swings it takes.

bush.name: Thorny Bush
bush.hint: Thick thorny growth. Something sharp could cut through it.
bush.push_message: You force your way through the thorns. Ouch.

rock.name: Boulder
rock.hint: A heavy boulder. A pickaxe could break it.
rock.push_message: You heave the loose boulder aside.
